extensionDescription.message: Briefly highlights duplicate tabs when you open a tab that is already open elsewhere.

showCounterLabel.message: Show duplicate count on the icon

showCounterDesc.message: Shows briefly after you open a tab (at least 2 seconds).

enableDuplicateHighlightLabel.message: Highlight duplicates when you open a tab

enableDuplicateHighlightDesc.message: When you go to a tab that already has a copy open, the other copies light up briefly.

enableHoverHighlightLabel.message: Highlight matching tabs when you hover a link

hoverDelayDesc.message: How long to wait before highlighting after you hover a link.

autoHideDelayDesc.message: How long to highlight duplicates after opening a tab. The icon counter stays at least 2 seconds, or as long as this value if it is higher. 0 keeps the highlight on.

unhighlightOnWindowLeaveLabel.message: Clear highlight when the cursor leaves the page for the browser panels
